lines.en: : Hey! We made eye contact so that means you have to hang out with me now.
lines.zh: : 嘿！我们对上眼了，也就是说你现在必须陪我。

lines.en: : I had no idea such a rule existed.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还有这种规矩。

lines.en: : It exists and if you break it, I get to cut your arms off and wrap them around myself so I can be eternally hugged.
lines.zh: : 有的，而且你要是违反，我就可以把你的胳膊砍下来缠在我身上，这样我就能被永远抱着了。

lines.en: Noriko and I spend the evening hanging out in the hallway, doing nothing in particular.
lines.zh: Noriko 和我晚上在走廊里待着，也没干什么特别的。

lines.en: Some of the other girls wind up walking by and seeing us chatting.
lines.zh: 后来有几个女孩路过，看见我们在聊天。

lines.en: I can tell that they want to get involved as well, but either out of respect for Noriko (Or for fear of her existence), they abstain.
lines.zh: 我看得出她们也想凑过来，但也许是出于对 Noriko 的尊重（或者是怕她这个人），她们都没过来。

lines.en: Before I know it, it's almost midnight and I can already hear Ami scolding me for taking too long to get home...
lines.zh: 不知不觉就快到午夜了，我已经能听见 Ami 骂我回家太慢……
